response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced full-stack and systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship credentials, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang rather than Java/Kotlin/JVM tooling. He lists Java only as a peripheral skill (robotic arms, mobile orchestration tooling) with no evidence of deep JVM internals knowledge, Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience, or IDE tooling development, all of which are core requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level experience across web, mobile, and systems programming
Strong track record of ownership, mentoring, and driving technical practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Demonstrated interest in developer tooling and building libraries/frameworks (test runners, assertion libraries)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise Java frameworks
Java appears only as a minor, dated skill rather than a core competency; no Kotlin experience listed
No evidence of IDE internals, language tooling, or JVM-specific development work

key_factors.factor: Lack of Spring/enterprise Java framework experience
No Kotlin or JVM tooling background
Strong general software engineering seniority and craftsmanship
